caption: The drawing features a side view of a horse-drawn sleigh composed primarily of curved lines and elongated forms. The body of the sleigh is painted in a dark grayish-black color with a smooth, glossy appearance, and has an elegant, open structure with a high front and slightly lower rear section. The sleigh's runners and supporting framework are detailed in a bright red color, featuring intricate loops and scrollwork for decoration and support. The interior is upholstered in deep red, visible on the cushions, backrests, and the lining, with the rear compartment containing a large, plush seat with vertically tufted padding and the front section designed for another, smaller seat, also padded in red. Thin, black railings run atop the back of the front seat for additional support or ornamentation. The background is plain and off-white, keeping the focus on the sleigh without any additional objects present.
title: Sleigh
